title: FLUID
subtitle: Nine oval diamonds, each precisely matched at a quarter carat, set in an unbroken circle — but unlike any eternity band that came before it, FLUID moves. The shank is engineered to flex, contouring to the finger as it bends, shifts, and lives. Where traditional bands resist the hand, FLUID yields to it. The result is a piece that doesn't just sit on the finger — it belongs there. The oval cut was chosen deliberately. Of all diamond shapes, the oval is the most naturally graceful — no hard corners, no sharp angles, only continuous curves that echo the band's own logic. Worn still, it catches light in long, sweeping flashes. Worn in motion, it becomes something else entirely. FLUID was designed for motion. That is the point.
